title: Breezeway Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutBreezeway ~ 112 Savelle Drive ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Breezeway is a delightful family friendly home located in the private, highly sought-after neighborhood of Gulf Trace in Grayton Beach. With 4,746 square feet of living (2,882 interior), Breezeway accommodates up to 12 guests and offers 4 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, parking for up to 4 cars, a private pool (not heated), and a 3-minute stroll to the neighborhood beach access. Breezeway also features multiple spacious deck areas including a 4th level crow’s nest with stunning views of the gulf. Being surrounded by the Grayton Beach State Park gives guests of the Gulf Trace neighborhood ONE FULL MILE of beautiful, undisturbed beaches to enjoy; 2 private neighborhood beach accesses. PLEASE NOTE - Golf carts and on-street parking are STRICTLY PROHIBITED in the Gulf Trace neighborhood, per neighborhood covenants. Breezeway borders the Grayton Beach State Park, named America’s #1 Beach in 2020 by Dr. Stephen Leatherman, aka Dr. Beach! “This beach boasts of its sugar-white sand and emerald green water where development has been restrained so big sand dunes still dominate the landscape. At the same time, all the amenities of great restaurants and accommodations are close by in the old town of Grayton Beach or Seaside," wrote Leatherman. Originally named the country’s top beach in 1994, Grayton Beach State Park has been listed FOUR times since 1991, finishing 6th in 2016 and 3rd in 2019. First Level: 2 Bedrooms. 2 Full Baths. Laundry Room. Back Door with Access to Pool Area. #1 En-Suite bedroom has two queen beds, tub/shower. Full Hall Bathroom, walk-in-shower. #2 Bedroom has one king bed (This has been updated from 2 twin beds to a king). Second Level: 2 Bedrooms. 2 Full Baths. Kitchen. Dining Table seats up to 8. Vaulted Living Room. Covered Porch with Access to crow’s nest with Gulf Views. #3 En-Suite bedroom has two queen beds, walk-in-shower. Hallway Bath, walk-in-shower. #4 Master Bedroom has one king bed. Third Level: Bonus living area. Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 6 Flat Screen TV’s Distinctive Features Private pool (not heated) 3-minute walk to private neighborhood beach access Borders Grayton Beach State Park Vaulted living area Private Gulf front neighborhood surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park and the Gulf Bed, bath, and kitchen linens provided (no beach towels) Beach Gear Credit General Features Carport and open parking for 4 vehicles 2 King Beds, 4 Queen beds. 4 Full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, 4 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/grill utensils, outdoor shower, outdoor porch, porch furniture, 3-story crow’s nest with Gulf views Ring Doorbell Cam on Front Entrance Door Linens provided. No Smoking. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, Hamilton Beach K-cup + drip coffee maker, induction range, refrigerator with ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, washer, dryer, gas grill, grill utensils. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Downtown Grayton Beach (1.5 miles) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
